name: glyhub_GPST000035_s27_hct_15

description: Complete O-glycan peak-area profile from source panel S27 HCT 15, in the study of cell-line-specific O-glycosylation. All 13 source quantitative features and 2 replicate observations are retained.
details: The 2 observations are source-labelled technical replicates in this panel. Source biological and technical replicate designations are retained in colData where stated. Panels are separate because source retention-time isomers cannot be safely aligned across independent cell-line sheets. Fetuin is a quality-control standard rather than a cell line. Sulfation is encoded as a substituent where supported.
